reason: The band is real (measured, panel padding-top 88px; at 390 the sheet spans y275-832 and the first visible text, WHAT IT IS, sits at 364 - an 89px blank), but the argument this fix rests on is false and the fix itself is a net worsening. (1) The panel is not anonymous to a sighted owner. The row being edited carries a tinted halo plate (.b-item[data-editing] .b-copy, fore-06 with a 12px spread) and is GUARANTEED on screen: keepInBand() scrolls it above the sheet and interaction-check.mjs already asserts 'the row being edited is on screen when it opens @ 390' and '@ 768'. Driven at 390 the tinted row 'Send the invitations' sits at y94-165, 110px clear above the sheet; at 1440 the panel is in the rail and the tinted row sits directly beside it at the same vertical band. On top of that the first field in the panel is labelled WHAT IT IS and holds the name at --size-lead (17px), the largest text in the panel - which is how every editor of this shape names its subject (Linear's issue panel, Stripe's edit drawers). 'Told only by reading the title field' describes the convention, not a defect. (2) The fix would print the same string three times inside 250px: the tinted row above, the proposed 'Editing <name>' caption, and the title input 22px below it - and would re-echo it on every keystroke of a rename directly above the field being typed into. At the 9.5 bar a studio cuts that repetition, it does not add it. (3) The proposed swap is self-defeating: data-undo hides the name the instant the undo bar fills, so the caption exists only while nothing has happened and disappears exactly when a change has been made and the owner might want to know what they changed. (4) The 1440 description is wrong. The rail is not 'a panel that is otherwise the only thing in a column with 600px of empty below it': the horizon block (79 days / Saturday 3 October / today's line) occupies y231-597 above it, and the panel runs to y1154 against a 960px viewport - 194px already past the fold, so the column below it is not idle space the band can be excused by. (5) It recovers nothing on the phone, which is the finding's own stated stake: the sheet stays 557px, the 88px stays spent, and it is now spent on a repeat instead of on nothing. Whether the reserve should be re-sited at all is the geometry question two other seats raised; judged on its own merits, THIS fix makes the editor worse.
